sensors.name: Docker Compose Config Validation
sensors.description: Validates all Docker Compose files for syntax and configuration errors

sensors.name: Docker Swarm Compose Config Validation
sensors.description: Validates the swarm deployment Docker Compose file

sensors.name: Environment File Check
sensors.description: Ensures .env file exists for local development

sensors.name: Nginx Configuration Syntax Test
sensors.description: Validates nginx configuration template syntax (requires nginx binary or docker)
sensors.command: docker run --rm -v $(pwd)/nginx/default.conf.template:/tmp/default.conf:ro nginx:alpine nginx -t -c /tmp/default.conf 2>&1 || echo 'SKIP: nginx template uses envsubst variables; syntax test in container may fail on env vars'
sensors.expectedOutput: Config syntax check (may skip due to envsubst)

sensors.name: Git Submodule Status Check
sensors.description: Checks if all git submodules are initialized and at expected commits
sensors.expectedOutput: All submodules prefixed with space (clean) or + (different commit) but not - (uninitialized)

sensors.name: Makefile Target Validation
sensors.description: Ensures key Makefile targets are executable (dry-run check)
sensors.command: make -n help && make -n start && make -n stop

sensors.name: Dockerfile Lint (Hadolint)
sensors.description: Lints the nginx gateway Dockerfile using Hadolint (matching CI)

sensors.name: Conventional Commits Check
sensors.description: Verifies recent commit messages follow Conventional Commits format
sensors.command: git log --oneline -10 --format='%s' | grep -vE '^(feat|fix|docs|refactor|test|chore|style|perf|ci|build|revert)(\(.+\))?:' | grep -v '^$' && echo 'WARN: Some commits may not follow Conventional Commits' || echo 'PASS: Commits follow Conventional Commits'
sensors.expectedOutput: Commits validated against Conventional Commits pattern

sensors.name: Docker Services Health Check
sensors.description: Checks health status of all running services
sensors.command: docker compose ps --format json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; services=[json.loads(l) for l in sys.stdin]; unhealthy=[s['Name'] for s in services if 'Health' in s and s['Health'] not in ('','healthy')]; sys.exit(1) if unhealthy else print('PASS: All services healthy')" 2>/dev/null || echo 'SKIP: Services not fully running or no health checks configured'
sensors.expectedOutput: All services healthy or skip if not running

sensors.name: OpenAPI Schema Validation
sensors.description: Checks for OpenAPI/Swagger schema files in services
sensors.command: find . -name 'swagger.yaml' -o -name 'swagger.json' -o -name 'openapi.yaml' -o -name 'openapi.json' | head -1 && echo 'FOUND: OpenAPI schema exists' || echo 'INFO: No OpenAPI schema files found at umbrella level'
